Final categorization: POSSIBLE  
(Justification: This is a non-review research paper that uses future land-cover change scenarios (A2 and B1) as inputs to model gibbon range shifts under climate and land-cover change. However, the land-cover projections are not generated by the authors; they are adopted from an external source (GeoSOS-FLUS, Li et al., 2017). The primary focus of the study is on species distribution modeling and conservation prioritization for gibbons, not on LULC prediction itself. The study covers multiple countries across Southeast Asia (global/transboundary scale) without focusing on a single nation’s entire territory, thus failing the national-scale requirement. While it implements multiple future scenarios and uses spatial modeling, LULC prediction is incidental—not the central research objective—and no accuracy metrics for LULC are reported because the authors did not produce the LULC data. Therefore, it meets the definition of 'POSSIBLE': LULC prediction is used as an input but is not the primary focus.)
